product.summary: Electron-based MyCrypto desktop application introduced to handle private keys, mnemonics, and keystore files outside the browser environment.
product.notes: The official MyCrypto Help Center identifies the desktop application as part of an older MyCrypto version that is not actively maintained. The official download remains reachable; support_status=ended records the maintenance state and does not imply the binary is unavailable or unusable.

events.title: MyCrypto Desktop officially launched
events.description: MyCrypto released its stable desktop applications and moved raw private-key, mnemonic, and keystore-file access out of the web interface into the desktop application.

events.title: Consensys acquired MyCrypto
events.description: Consensys announced the acquisition of MyCrypto to combine its work with MetaMask while MyCrypto stated that its existing products would continue operating in the short term.
events.notes: The acquisition announcement described gradual product convergence rather than an immediate MyCrypto shutdown.

evidence.title: MyCrypto Launches Desktop Applications w/ Hardware Wallet Support
evidence.notes: Primary launch source for MyCrypto Desktop and the browser-to-desktop key-handling boundary.

evidence.title: Consensys Acquires MyCrypto to Strengthen MetaMask Partnership and Enhance Web3 Experiences
evidence.notes: Primary acquiring-company announcement for the MyCrypto acquisition and planned MetaMask collaboration.

evidence.title: MyCrypto is Joining MetaMask to Lead The Way to Web3
evidence.notes: Primary MyCrypto-side acquisition announcement stating products would not immediately go away and longer-term convergence would be gradual.

evidence.title: Download MyCrypto
evidence.notes: Current official desktop download endpoint remains reachable; this does not by itself establish active maintenance.

evidence.title: MyCrypto official source repository
evidence.notes: Official public repository remains non-archived; repository metadata identifies MyCrypto as an open-source Ethereum account-management tool.

evidence.title: MyCrypto Release 1.7.17
evidence.notes: Latest formal GitHub release visible at review time; used to justify conservative limited/unknown-support treatment rather than an unsupported active-maintenance claim.

evidence.title: Verifying the Authenticity of the Desktop Application
evidence.notes: Current first-party help page; it reports a last-updated date of 2021-10-25 and explicitly states that the desktop application belongs to an older MyCrypto version that is not actively maintained while the download remains available.
